name: 306 The Second Lap
source: Friends are entangled in a dangerous game that threatens their relationships, values and questions their nature. With one person having to leave the game each day, they are forced to choose between who stays and who leaves, while something sinister lurks around them...
translation: 朋友们陷入了一场危险的游戏，这场游戏威胁着他们的关系、价值观，并质疑他们的本性。每天都有一个人必须离开游戏，他们被迫在谁留下和谁离开之间做出选择，而一些险恶的东西潜伏在他们周围……
